recent_messages.content:
The bug is in the `timer = null;` line at the end of the inner function. This line unconditionally sets the timer to null after scheduling, which means the pending `setTimeout` is never actually cleared. The check `if (timer !== null)` will always be false on subsequent calls, so new calls return early without cancelling the previous timer. The correct behavior is to clear the existing timer (with `clearTimeout`) before scheduling a new one.
